name: dainty-lass-launcher
description: The Tauri CLI for the two desktop apps over dainty-lass's MIT shell (crates/dainty-launcher-app, RL13). Their release scripts are MIT in dainty-lass's launcher/ (RD27), run through scripts/lass.ts.

scripts.build:pages: bun ../../crates/dainty-launcher-app/scripts/page.ts build launcher && bun ../../crates/dainty-launcher-app/scripts/page.ts build server-manager
scripts.build:all: bun run build:client && bun run build:manager
